'''Tulo the Fearless''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] living during or after the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tulo the Fearless was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' with [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion as a World Boss for Dark vs. Light system. Whenever [[Light side of the Force]] reaches victory state on a server, Tulo the Fearless has a chance to spawn at one or more of selected locations on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] alongside other Light Side World Bosses. Though killing him is required for an in-game achievement, it is impossible to determine the year when his death took place.
